name: Honda CBR1000F
engine: 998 cc liquid-cooled inline four, four carbs, linked brakes on later bikes
intro: Honda's big enclosed sport tourer of the late 80s and early 90s. Later bikes have linked brakes.

G: Rebuild one carb at a time and keep each one's parts apart.
K: Later bikes have linked brakes. Bleed them in the order the manual gives.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
